command_templates.name: export_lnk_files
command_templates.when: When you need to export LNK files from JumpList files.

usage_description: JumpList Explorer is a tool for parsing and visualizing JumpList files, which contain information about user activity in Windows applications. It can be used to extract LNK files, explore AutomaticDestinations, CustomDestinations, and search through the data.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Unusual or frequent access patterns to sensitive locations.
suspicious_indicators.description: Indicates potential user activity that may be of interest.
May indicate unexplained or unknown application usage.

known_false_positives: Normal user behavior such as accessing common directories might generate false positives.
